prospects.signals_text: Early-stage Indian AI/LLMOps SaaS startup founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni, offices in Bengaluru and San Jose. Builds AI infrastructure (AI Gateway, MCP Gateway, LLMOps). Actively hiring AI/ML engineers, including Senior AI/ML Engineer for the LLM and Agent Stack.
prospects.subject: Hiring AI engineers at TrueFoundry
prospects.body:
Saw you are currently hiring a Senior AI/ML Engineer in Bengaluru for your LLM and agent stack.

Finding candidates with hands-on experience in agent frameworks and LLMOps is difficult right now. We help early-stage Indian startups source and screen pre-vetted AI engineers to fill open roles faster.

Would you be open to reviewing two or three candidate profiles for this position this week?
prospects.critic_note: The draft directly references TrueFoundry's specific open role for a Senior AI/ML Engineer on their LLM and agent stack in Bengaluru, stays strictly within word limits, and asks a single clear question.

prospects.signals_text: YC W22 backed fintech and agentic SaaS startup, $4.1M seed, active in Singapore and India. Hiring a Machine Learning Engineer Intern (paid, India/remote) and an AI Automation Engineer.
